MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Show 8 feels relevant because I already use an Echo Show 5, and a larger display could serve another room instead of simply repeating what I have.",
    "The Fire HD 10 interests me because it offers portable browsing and video watching on a larger screen, giving me a use beyond my existing Alexa devices."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The first-generation Show 5 devices and Fire TV Stick 4K repeat needs covered by my recent second-generation Show 5 and Fire TV Stick 4K Max purchases.",
    "The stands and replacement remote lack an immediate purpose: I already bought a Show 5 stand, do not own a Show 8, and have no current remote replacement need.",
    "The Fire TV Cube and Echo Auto interest me, but interest alone does not make them immediate choices: my current TV setup is recent, and I would need to check the Echo Auto's connection to my car."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repeated Alexa purchases seem to be taken as interest in almost any Alexa device, even when it duplicates something I recently bought.",
    "Owning a related device seems to be treated as a reason to want its accessories or another color, without a clear additional use."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The timing and generation of my recent purchases matter: an older version is less appealing when I just bought a newer one serving the same purpose.",
    "I respond better to an added capability, such as a larger display or portable screen, than to another device that does the same job.",
    "Accessories need to fit the specific device I own and fill an actual gap; a possible future device purchase does not create that need yet."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in Alexa and home electronics, but missed how recent purchases and distinct uses determine what I would choose next."
}
